reviews.reason: The claim form lists an admission date of 03/10/2024, which directly contradicts the 07 Oct 2024 date recorded on the hospital bill and discharge summary.
The hospital bill total payable of 55901.63 plus the pharmacy bill of 530.00 mathematically equals the total amount claimed of 56431.63, so there is no discrepancy.
The slight spelling difference of 'Sundaramm' on the pharmacy invoice is a minor typographical error and does not constitute a real documentation discrepancy for the same patient.
